subject: Staged close cadence & finance checklist for private offer (TideView)
messages:
From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha@tideview.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Staged close cadence & finance checklist for private offer (TideView)

Hi Samantha — thanks again for the product demo last week. Per our conversation, attached is a concise mutual action plan (MAP) that sequences the evaluation checkpoints, legal review window, and the billing handoff for the AWS private offer.

High-level asks from your side:
- Confirm who in Procurement will sign the PO (name + title).
- Confirm whether your finance team needs an escrow or net-30 invoice route.
- Any SOC2 evidence requests beyond what I attached (SOC2 summary).

What I put in the MAP (attached):
1) 2-week technical acceptance window with an engineering checklist for runtimes and quantization profiles.
2) Legal review: 5 business days allocated for initial Redlines; we’ve indicated a single redline pass to keep momentum.
3) Billing: we propose DocuSign PO + AWS private-offer activation; finance handoff 48 hours after signed PO.
4) Kickoff call: schedule on your side the day after PO is countersigned.

Attachments: TideView_MAP_v1.pdf, SOC2_evidence_summary.xlsx

Planned internal owners: Marissa (deal lead), Karthik (technical), Laura (legal), Michael (finance).

If that sequencing looks good, I can convert the MAP to a shared Google Sheet and set milestone reminders.

Thanks —
Hiro
Hiro Tanaka
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
hiro.tanaka@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Samantha Cole <samantha@tideview.ai>
To: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Staged close cadence & finance checklist for private offer (TideView)

Hi Hiro — appreciate the clear MAP. A few clarifying items from procurement and finance: 

1) Signer: I will be the signer (Samantha Cole, Head of Procurement).
2) Payment terms: tideview typically requires a net-30 invoice route; our finance team will request a PDF invoice after activation. Is that supported, or do we need to use AWS invoice flow?
3) SOC2: the summary is great; we do need a short spreadsheet with data retention and logging details (timestamps, retention windows) to pass our InfoSec gating checklist.

Also, legal has a conditional around export controls — can you confirm whether any model weights or derivative outputs are restricted under Redwood’s standard privacy terms? Our legal says that needs explicit callout.

I can do the technical acceptance window 11/30–12/14 (two weeks). Does that align with your proposed dates?

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Cole
Head of Procurement, TideView Analytics
samantha@tideview.ai

From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Staged close cadence & finance checklist for private offer (TideView)

Fwding Samantha’s responses — quick internal plan:

- Samantha will sign (Procurement). Finance prefers net-30 PDF invoice flow instead of marketplace invoice; Michael, can we support net-30 with AWS private offer activation? How long to issue invoice post-activation?
- Laura — legal flagged export control language. Can you review the MAP and confirm whether a short clause calling out "model weights not distributed; outputs under customer ownership" is sufficient? They want it explicit.
- Karthik/Marissa — technical acceptance window proposed 11/30–12/14. We should prepare the acceptance checklist (KV cache behavior, latency at 99th percentile, sample prompts). Karthik, can you own the checklist doc?

I'll convert the MAP into a shared Sheet if we agree on the finance/legal bits.

Thanks —
Hiro

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha@tideview.ai>
Cc: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Staged close cadence & finance checklist for private offer (TideView)

Hi Samantha — looping in the owners and thanks for the clear asks. Quick answers inline: 

- Signer: confirmed (Samantha).
- Finance flow: Michael, Redwood can support a net-30 PDF invoice post-activation for AWS private offers, but the sequence is: DocuSign PO -> AWS private-offer activation -> Redwood issues vendor invoice (PDF) -> net-30 payment term on our vendor invoice. We typically invoice within 48 business hours of activation unless a special escrow is requested.
- SOC2/data-retention: attaching a compact table (SOC2_evidence_summary.xlsx) with retention windows and logs. Laura — I flagged the export control language to you in the MAP redlines.

Attached: TideView_MAP_v1.pdf (updated with a single legal clause recommended below), SOC2_evidence_summary.xlsx

Laura — proposed language to close the export concern: 
"Redwood Inference does not distribute model weights to customers; model execution is performed in a sandboxed runtime. Customer outputs are owned by the customer; Redwood will not assert IP over customer-provided data or derived outputs for the purposes of this agreement."

If that looks acceptable we’ll add it to the PO appendix and proceed. Karthik — are you able to have the acceptance checklist doc ready by 11/24 so TideView can prep before the 11/30 start?

Next steps: if legal signoff is green, I will send the DocuSign PO with the MAP attached and Michael will queue the invoice issuance flow.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Samantha Cole <samantha@tideview.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Andrew Lin <andrew@tideview.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Staged close cadence & finance checklist for private offer (TideView)

Marissa/Hiro — thanks, that language looks fine to our legal counsel and the SOC2 sheet covers the InfoSec ask. We signed the PO and returned it via DocuSign (attached Signed_PO_9876.pdf).

Two final notes: 
- Please confirm activation ETA after DocuSign completes (we’d like activation before 11/30).
- For the invoice, please make sure it references PO #TV-9876 and includes the net-30 terms. Our AP team will process once received.

Andrew (cc) will join the technical kickoff on day one of the acceptance window.

Attached: Signed_PO_9876.pdf

Best,
Samantha
